name: LUCAS New Zealand Land Use Map
description: Nationwide time-series land-use classification for carbon accounting, separate from NZLRI land-use capability.
story: The Ministry for the Environment's Land Use and Carbon Analysis System (LUCAS) maps land-use classes used to monitor land-use change and report land-sector emissions and removals. The five representative dates are 1989, 2007, 2012, 2016 and 2020.

LUCAS is a land-use dataset, not the New Zealand Land Resource Inventory or its Land Use Capability classification. Its categories are based on remotely sensed land cover and supporting interpretation, with a particular emphasis on forests.
